top_violation_types.title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §746.4501(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A table manufactured for use with safety straps does not have safety straps on it. Children were observed at the table without being strapped in.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Sanitation Inspection - Inspection not available, you must obtain documentation stating inspection not available (26 TAC §746.3401(c)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Operation did not have letter from Local Health Department or judge stating that sanitation inspection not available.  Must be renewed annually.

top_violation_types.title: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.1105(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have form 2985 notarized.

top_violation_types.title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders (26 TAC §746.3317(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Crackers were served on a bare table for children to eat from.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out (26 TAC §746.2805(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A 18 mo old was observed to be sitting in a highchair upon arrival. A volunteer was observed removing the child from the chair and telling them they could not hit and not to hit again. The caregiver of the gorup initally stated the chair is only used for eating. After being informed of the volunteer's statement, the caregiver then stated it is used but for only 1 minute.

top_violation_types.title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have current training in pediatric CPR.

top_violation_types.title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone (26 TAC §745.621(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A caregiver, with direct access to children, was present without a background check eligibility.  The caregiver was sent home during the inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services (26 TAC §746.501(a)(30))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policies were lacking information related to the support of inclusive services.
